verdict.rationale: Limitless exposes an API, API keys, and an MCP server that agents can connect to, so operator-enforced limits on what an agent may access are a fair question for this product. However, the evidence shows no scoped or permissioned keys and no allowlists of surfaces or accounts. Per-key rate limits and the rule that users can only delete their own chats are adjacent controls, not operator-configured restrictions on the agent.
